description: Stop a run that is pending, running, or waiting for input, and its media generations still in flight. A run mid-step finishes that step first: it returns with cancel_requested_at set and settles as cancelled moments later (wait_for_run to confirm). Repeating it is harmless.
name: cancel_run

outputSchema.description: A task run — one delegated job and what is known about its state.

cancel_requested_at.description: Set once a stop was requested; the run stays running until it reaches its next step, then settles as cancelled.

wait_timed_out.description: The wait ended first. The work is still running: follow it with the tool next_step names.
